domain: Pinned Authority.transaction and Authority.handle boundary alternatives, with Authority.sign/fault reached by listed requests. This finite partition is not all combinations or all program paths.

paths.available_evidence: All request/unit executions enter BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
paths.remaining_gap: BEGIN failure (lock/I/O/connection) not executed; BEGIN is outside transaction try; no rollback by this function then. Local test gap; deployment lock/I/O behavior unqualified.

paths.available_evidence: claim/persist/admission commits visible in reopened authenticated exports.
paths.remaining_gap: Not every method body, concurrency or disk-failure schedule.

paths.available_evidence: rollback request: source OSError traverses sign → generator → handler, SQL rollback attempt, reverted signature event after reopen.
paths.remaining_gap: All exception classes and implicit-operation failures not exhausted.

paths.available_evidence: controls.json: journal write followed by KeyboardInterrupt, actual transaction rollback and exact reopened equality.
paths.remaining_gap: Harness body only; complete request-path BaseException unwind tracing unfinished.

No failed COMMIT injection. Source catches BaseException and attempts ROLLBACK; commit outcome may be ambiguous. Need SQLite failure/uncertainty fixture and reopened evidence; power-loss durability additionally needs qualified evidence.
No failing ROLLBACK execution. A rollback exception may replace the original exception; state unresolved. Requires a dedicated local failure fixture, not an assertion of restoration.

paths.available_evidence: replay.json: four REPLAY failures outside dispatch catch; prior state unchanged. Normal journal admission covered.
paths.remaining_gap: Malformed/authentication/role/capacity failures not freshly covered; prior scopes preserved. This slice does not repeat journal-boundary tests.

paths.available_evidence: claim-ord, claim-zk, rollback, postpersist: exact source OSError transformed to authenticated saved error response.
paths.remaining_gap: Other signer/runtime exceptions unexecuted; no external outcome classification.

Non-sign dispatch, apply failure and retire/open/decide/release/retry_release/observe postcommit faults have static source locations but no new execution oracle here. Need separately bounded method-specific before/after inputs. No full-path claim.

paths.available_evidence: base-exception: KeyboardInterrupt escapes, claim survives, null journal response, no charge reset.
paths.remaining_gap: Trace hook injection disables later Python tracing; source catch class excludes BaseException but full dynamic propagation trace remains unavailable locally.

paths.available_evidence: Ordinary transformed errors and success-before-update-denial have exact response values and valid server envelopes.
paths.remaining_gap: Encoding/signing/RESPONSE-BOUND failures not injected; outside dispatch catch, prior effects may persist. Missing source full-domain response size bounds remain separate.

paths.available_evidence: Two actual SQLite authorizer denials: DatabaseError escapes outside method handler, response transaction rolls back, prior claim/signed state preserved.
paths.remaining_gap: Authorizer denial is a controlled SQLite failure, not an I/O/commit/power-loss simulation.

No ambiguous response COMMIT fixture. A missing observed return cannot decide whether response or prior effects persisted; reopen/reconcile required. Local injection plus qualified durability obligations remain.

paths.available_evidence: claim/rollback/postpersist return exact persisted authenticated envelope, independently checked.
paths.remaining_gap: Interruption after response COMMIT but before delivery unexecuted; no delivery guarantee.

paths.available_evidence: exit-rollback: actual os._exit(source exit code), no Python rollback trace, fresh-process reopen retains claim only and unanswered journal.
paths.remaining_gap: SQLite crash recovery on this lab filesystem only; power loss, rollback resistance and external signing copies unqualified.

paths.available_evidence: exit-postpersist: actual os._exit, exact signed transaction/event retained, response missing, replay blocked.
paths.remaining_gap: No external execution/nonexecution conclusion, nor lifetime storage bound.
